description: Deterministic single-turn tasks. Success is checked by exact match, substring, or a required tool call. No LLM judge.

tasks.prompt: Reverse the string 'pocket-harness' and output only the reversed string, with no other text.
Output a JSON object with the key "status" set to "ok". Output only the JSON object.
How many words are in the sentence: 'The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog'? Output only the number.
Convert the string 'local-first inference' to uppercase. Output only the uppercase string.
